title: Recurring sales and purchasing subscriptions
summary: Generate invoices or purchase orders automatically on a schedule.

steps.text: Open {sales} or {purch} from the sidebar to see sales and purchasing subscriptions separately.
Choose {new} to create a subscription, or {imp} to bring in many at once from a file.
The status cards above the list, including {all}, let you filter by stage with one click.
Click a subscription to open it: its lines, its {sched} of billing periods and the invoices each period produced.
You can also ask the assistant to generate the invoices that are due, or to pause, resume, cancel or change a subscription. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
